Bwahahahahahahaah!

Airship enterprise by

train in Umbala to overcome
any acrophobia they might have through bungee jumping. Neat, eh?

scripts.speaker: Chrmlim
scripts.text:
But...
Some of them couldn't
overcome their fear of
heights. And a few even
ended up, um, ^333333in Niflheim^000000.

Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.

I am currently on a
sacred journey, offering
prayer for the sake of the
Midgard continent.

scripts.speaker: Maelin
scripts.text:
Um, this Airship is
to Lutie, isn't it? I've
waiting so long,
but I haven't heard any
broadcast about Lutie.

scripts.speaker: Aanos
scripts.text:
Oh wooow~
The sky looks
so different and
pretty from up there!

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
I wish that I could go drink a cold fresh beer.
Drinking is the goal of my life! Drinking gives me energy!
I am nothing without drinks!

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
But! Driving under the influence is not good.
But! That makes me want to drink more and more!
Do you know a passenger named Thierry?

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer. I could just strip to my boxers.

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text: Wah!? Who is it!
- ...He is not listening to you, at all. -

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
It's been sooo
long since I've
enjoyed a nice, cold
alcoholic brew. But the
job requires me to be as
clear headed as I can!

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
Always drink responsibly!
Still, I can't remember the
last time I had a real vacation
or even a day off. Yeap, some
booze, some chips, some TV
and serious R&R is in order.

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
Man, the weather
is really nice today.
Bright, open skies make
for some good visibility
and safe, carefree flying.

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
You know, our captain's a
respectable guy. Him and
his brother are actually well
known in the aircraft industry.
Who knew reindeer made
such good captains?

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
Just between you
and me, I gotta tell
you, that Santa was onto
something, getting reindeers
and elves to work for him.
The man must be a genius!

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
You know, this whole
piloting thing in the air,
it's rather new, you know?
Yeah, they got this Airship
operation in a hurry.

scripts.speaker: Pilot
scripts.text:
Still, they were real
serious, really thought
ahead. I mean, they had us
training while the Airships
were still being invented.
Isn't that freakin' crazy?!

scripts.speaker: Fruitz
scripts.text:
I used to be a wandering
vagabond when, one day,
I took a nap and something
struck my head and awoke
me from my restful slumber.

scripts.speaker: Fruitz
scripts.text:
It turns out that I was
sleeping beneath an apple
tree and that an apple fell
and hit me on the head.
I was dying of hunger and
was about to eat that Apple...

scripts.speaker: Fruitz
scripts.text:
But suddenly, Kain, my old
friend from the mining days,
asked me to help him around
on the Airship. So I did, and
it was there where I found some
people playing the Dice game.

scripts.speaker: Fruitz
scripts.text:
I was bored and curious
and ended up wagering that
single Apple in a game of
dice. But for some reason,
I had this incredible lucky
streak. One apple became two...

scripts.speaker: Fruitz
scripts.text:
Two became four and
before I knew it, I had
cornered the Apple market!
I won so many Apples, I just
started my own business here
on the Airship. Weird, huh?

scripts.speaker: Fruitz
scripts.text:
So Apples are good
for you. They were
certainly very good
to me. Hahahahaah~!

scripts.speaker: Fruitz
scripts.text:
Thank you for
using my shop.
Farewell~

How would you like
to wager some Apples
in a friendly game of Dice?

I'm up for a game of
dice whenever you feel
like it. Just talk to me if
you ever get hit with the
sudden urge to gamble, kay?

The rules for the Dice game
are pretty simple. First, you
place a bet by wagering Apples.
You can bet a maximum of 50
Apples at a time. To keep things
legal, I can only accept Apples.

But hey, if all that zeny
is burning a hole in your
pocket, head over to Fruitz
and you can buy as many
Apples as you want, playah~

Now, we begin with me
rolling two 6-sided dice.
When it's your turn, you'll
roll two 6-sided dice. After
that, both of us will have the
option of rolling a third die.

Now here's the important
thing. If your total is higher
than 12, you'll bust, meaning
that you lose. Otherwise, the
person with the higher total
is the winner. Got it?

Now, you'll be the first
to decide whether or not
you'll roll the third die. Then,
depending on your result, I'll
roll my third die... Or maybe not.

When you win, you'll
receive twice as many
Apples as you wagered.
But if we happen to tie, you
get the Apples that you bet
returned to you. Fair, right?

Ooh, so you'll play with
me? Great! How many
Apples would you like to bet?
Remember, you can wager
up to 50 Apples. If you'd like
to cancel, please enter '0'.

Changed your mind?
I understand. Well then,
I hope we can play sometime.

You can't bet more than

reasonable. Please enter
